verdict.rationale: SigNoz's dashboard docs cover all three parts of the story: a panel editor with seven panel types and live preview, four kinds of template variables (dynamic, query, custom, textbox), and sharing through a public URL or saved team views. Dashboards can also be exported and hand-edited as JSON. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard features, and an enumeration of which seven visualization types are offered.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Build panels in a dedicated editor: seven panel types with a live preview, switchable mid-edit without losing your formatting, units or thresholds.
Filter everything with variables: dynamic, query, custom and textbox variables.
Publish a dashboard publicly: a separate flow that generates a public URL anyone can open without logging in.
save any filter combination as a view your team can share.
Edit a dashboard as JSON: read, copy, download or hand-edit the whole spec in the app, without going through the API.
